name: Tech Mahindra Ltd.
business_summary: Mahindra group IT and BPS services provider with the highest communications-vertical weight among large Indian IT firms (telecom operators, enterprise, manufacturing, BFSI), on a margin-recovery turnaround. Q2 FY27: revenue Rs16,180 cr (+15.6% INR), US$1,693 mn (+2% q/q, cc +2.4% q/q, +7.2% y/y), EBIT margin 14.8% (+40 bp q/q, +270 bp y/y), PAT Rs1,586-1,610 cr (+33%), TCV US$1.02 bn (fourth straight quarter above US$1 bn); free cash flow down ~43% y/y. Board recommended a 1:1 bonus and a Rs15 dividend; management maintained its FY27 margin target. Mcap Rs1.79 lakh cr, P/E 31.3, dividend yield 2.8%.

revenue_mix.segment: IT and BPS services (communications ~1/3, enterprise, manufacturing, BFSI, other)
revenue_mix.geography: North America ~50% / Europe ~25% / rest of world ~25% (model estimate)

exposures.mechanism: ~92% of revenue foreign currency, INR ~45% of costs (model knowledge); ~25-30 bp margin per 1% INR on a 14.8% EBIT base => +3% = +85 bp = +5.7% EBIT; persistence 0.4, EV/MCap 0.95 => +2.2; trimmed to +1.8 for hedges and low base. Empirical -1.75 (t=-1.1), insignificant, wrong sign.

Revenue growth cc +7.2% y/y (4 straight quarters of >US$1 bn TCV; trailing 12m US$4.27 bn); high operating leverage with margin recovering (EBIT 14.8% vs 12.1% a year ago). +5% US/EU IT spend => +2.5 pp growth => EBIT +5% on thin base; at P/E 31 the equity effect ~+3.5.

evidence.note: Reuters: biggest jump in over six years on deal wins

exposures.mechanism: Communications/BPS and engineering exposure is among the most automatable (telecom ~1/3 of revenue, model estimate); +1 = ~3% repricing x 55% flow-through / 14.8% margin = -11% EBIT, persistence 0.4 => ~-4. Compare WIPRO -6, INFY -5.
